caption:
Long AI chats drift. Mixing topics makes answers worse. 🧠

New topic = new chat. If a chat gets long, ask: "Summarize what we decided in 5 bullets", then paste that summary into a fresh chat.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #aitools #promptengineering #aitips #productivity #workflow #techtips #techmendly

scenes.title: Summarize, then restart
scenes.user: Summarize what we decided so far in 5 short bullets.
scenes.reply:
Summary:
- Goal: launch in May
- Audience: local shops
- Tone: friendly
- Budget: small
- Next: draft the page
scenes.say: Try this. Ask the AI to summarize what you decided in five short bullets. Then copy that summary.

scenes.title: Reset the chat
scenes.say: Three steps. Ask for a short summary. Open a brand new chat. Paste the summary in first, then carry on.
An endless chat means mixed topics and missed details. A fresh chat gives focused, clear answers.
